[\begin{align} \frac{(k-1)-0}{6-2}&=\frac{3-(k-1)}{(-3+k)-6}\ (k-1)(k-9)&=4(-k+4)\ k^2-6k-7&=0\ (k+1)(k-7)&=0. \end{align}] Then the values of (k) such that ((2, 0), (6, k-1)) and ((-3+k, 3)) lie on a straight line are (k=-1) and (k=7.)
